question: The sides of two similar triangles are in the ratio 9 ∶ 4. Areas of these triangles are in the ratio
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any two similar triangles, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of areas = (Ratio of corresponding sides)²

⇒ Ratio of areas = (9 ÷ 4)²

⇒ Ratio of areas = 81 ÷ 16 = 81 : 16

**∴ The correct answer is 81 : 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The ratio of the corresponding sides of two similar triangles = 9 : 4

**Formula Used:**

If two triangles are similar, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Area(Δ₁) ÷ Area(Δ₂) = (Side₁ ÷ Side₂)²

 

 Side = 9 units
 Area = 81 sq. units
 Δ 1
 
 

 Side = 4 units
 Area = 16 sq. units
 Δ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of corresponding sides = 9 ÷ 4

⇒ Ratio of areas = (9)² ÷ (4)²

⇒ Ratio of areas = 81 ÷ 16

⇒ Therefore, the ratio of the areas of the two triangles is 81 : 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 81 : 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

When two triangles are similar, their corresponding angles are equal, and the ratio of their corresponding sides remains constant.

Ratio of Perimeters

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is directly equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of Altitudes and Medians

The ratio of corresponding altitudes, medians, or angle bisectors of two similar triangles is also equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of Volumes for 3D Similar Figures

If two 3D solids are similar, the ratio of their volumes is equal to the cube of the ratio of their corresponding linear dimensions (a³ : b³).
